Definition: Christ, Messiah, Anointed One — the promised King and deliverer anointed by the Spirit, fulfilled in Jesus of Nazareth.
BiblicalUsage: Christos translates Hebrew Mashiach. Kings, priests and prophets were anointed; Jesus is the Anointed One in whom all three offices meet, confessed by Peter: 'You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.'
TheologicalSignificance: Christos means our hope has a name and a throne. Jesus is not merely a teacher who points the way — He is God's promised King, anointed to save His people.
